cohort: The study included 128 obese female patients (BMI 30-34.9 kg/m2, 35-39.9 kg/m2, >40 kg/m2) undergoing robotic gynecologic surgery between January 2008 and August 2010.
finding: Robotic-assisted gynecologic surgery can be safely performed in severely morbidly obese patients, although conversion rates to laparotomy are higher with increasing obesity.
